ordinaryBraidManagement.scope: Actual A/B keyboard dispatch edges, permanent tap/segment receipts and sparse two-clock, held-input and braid endpoints. Wall-clock dispatch intervals do not reconstruct active hold durations or prove a physical controller. Complete saved receipts may include transient last events never sampled; those gaps remain explicit. Observed lastStep values are actual calls, including gated preparation and terminal calls. No missing input, hold check, hit or model interval is replayed. Real controller-page two-pointer/WebSocket integration and ordinary independent audit remain separate evidence.

encodingOrderEvidence.scope: Original reception order and frame bytes retained; encoding order is stable by actual recorded timestamp with reception-index ties. Consolidation synthesizes no state or frame.

observationScope: Actual browser input, permanent tap/segment receipts and sparse model-time, active-time, held-input and braid observations. Wall-clock key dispatch intervals are not active hold durations. Missing local events and sample gaps remain explicit; no input or rhythm replay occurs. The ordinary independent audit is separate. The approved recipe, observed win and at least eleven seconds of actual terminal hold are bound. Actual controller-page two-pointer/WebSocket integration is separately recorded alongside controlled TV-bridge fixtures; neither proves physical hardware. Original reception order, derived encoding mapping and real empty error arrays remain factual. The existing full decode is reused once; no recording recovery is assumed.

controllerTransportEvidence.scope: Browser-emulated two touch contacts produce trusted PointerEvents on the unchanged signed-asset controller.html/js; the controlled WebSocket server records actual outgoing strings. This checks the controller transport independently of the separately declared TV input-bridge/model checks, not physical phone hardware or a production Android server.
